# Technical reference: Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III

Exact-build facts only: never apply an address to another build or body. Status: camera-confirmed > corroborated > single source; disputed entries list their conflict. Follow Detail for the explanation.

## Trouble spots

| Rule | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Start or stop the ARM co-processor only between shots | camera-confirmed | [d1] |
| Write card files with 8.3 names from cached heap buffers | camera-confirmed | [d2] |
| Keep CPU reads of image memory below 0xc0000000 | camera-confirmed | [d2] |
| Check image-engine records against the bridge's limits | camera-confirmed | [d3] |
| Never write to the logical flash range | corroborated | [d4] |
| Only call code in a section that has already loaded | camera-confirmed | [d4] |
| A hung task does not trigger the watchdog | camera-confirmed | [d5] |
| Give added shooting states a handler for every event they can receive | camera-confirmed | [d6] |
